interval_years.quote: Every holder of a license or endorsement of such license issued under this Chapter shall renew his license and, if applicable, endorsement each year by payment of the annual renewal fee established by the board

required.quote: The board may establish and determine by rule minimum requirements relative to continuing professional development for the renewal or reinstatement of any license or special endorsement issued by the board.

available.quote: Temporary working permits to perform work as a journeyman plumber may be issued as required by R.S. 37:1376 and may be issued to a holder of a state license as a journeyman plumber from a state with like examinations, should that state recognize the Louisiana license

requirements.value: Temporary permits for journeyman plumbers from states with like examinations, if that state recognizes the Louisiana license, or where bona fide evidence shows applicant's experience can protect the public from defective plumbing. Temporary permits not available for master plumbers.
requirements.quote: may be issued to a holder of a state license as a journeyman plumber from a state with like examinations, should that state recognize the Louisiana license, or where other bona fide evidence shows that the applicant's past experience would be capable of protecting the public from defective plumbing.

exists.quote: The State Plumbing Board is created. The board, which shall be appointed by the governor, shall consist of one registered mechanical engineer who is also licensed by the State Plumbing Board, one plumbing inspector who is also licensed by the State Plumbing Board, five master plumbers, one journeyman plumber, one residential plumber limited, and two members of the public.

regulatory_model.quote: No natural person shall engage in doing the work of a journeyman plumber unless the person possesses a license or renewal thereof issued by the board.

credential_type.quote: the State Plumbing Board shall be the sole and exclusive agency in this state empowered to license natural persons and regulated business entities engaged or seeking to engage in the business of plumbing

is_mandatory.quote: No natural person shall engage in doing the work of a journeyman plumber unless the person possesses a license or renewal thereof issued by the board.

title_protection.quote: No natural person shall engage in the work of a master plumber unless he possesses a master plumber's license or renewal thereof issued by the board.

scope_protection.quote: No natural person shall engage in doing the work of a journeyman plumber unless the person possesses a license or renewal thereof issued by the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Falsification of any material portion of a licensee's application or other requisite submission to the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Falsification of any material portion of a licensee's application or other requisite submission to the board including but not limited to insurance, work, training, or experience verifications.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Habitual performance of work substantially below standards established by the Louisiana Department of Health or not in compliance with regulations
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The habitual performance of the work of either a residential plumber limited, journeyman plumber, or a master plumber which is substantially below the standards established by the Louisiana Department of Health or any of its agencies or offices

disciplinary_grounds.description: Refusal of a master plumber, after notice from the board, to accurately designate an employment entity
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The refusal of a master plumber, after notice from the board, to accurately designate an employment entity in his application, his renewal thereof, or upon any change in employment status with an employing entity.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Habitual practice of a master plumber to knowingly allow an employing entity to hold itself out as engaging in plumbing when the master plumber is not actually employed there
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The habitual practice of a master plumber to knowingly allow any employing entity to hold itself out as engaging in the business of plumbing at a time when the employing entity does not employ the master plumber as designated to the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Habitual practice of knowingly allowing any person not licensed by the board to perform plumbing work or medical gas piping installation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The habitual practice of a residential plumber limited, journeyman plumber, master plumber, medical gas piping installer, or holder of a water supply protection specialist endorsement to knowingly allow any person not licensed by the board to perform plumbing work, medical gas piping installation, or the work of a water supply protection specialist

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of municipal or other local plumbing codes not otherwise preempted by this Chapter as evidenced by adjudication before local governing authorities
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The violation of municipal or other local plumbing codes not otherwise preempted by this Chapter or related regulations as evidenced by adjudication before local governing authorities.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Habitual violation by a licensee of the rules and regulations adopted by the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The habitual violation by a master plumber, journeyman plumber, residential plumber limited, apprentice plumber, medical gas piping installer, medical gas and vacuum systems verifier, or holder of a water supply protection specialist endorsement of the rules and regulations adopted by the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Habitual violation of any rules or regulations adopted by the board by a gas fitter or master gas fitter
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The habitual violation of any rules or regulations adopted by the board by a gas fitter or master gas fitter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of any municipal code or any other code adopted by the board related to gas fitting as evidenced by adjudication from a local governing authority
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The violation of any municipal code, any other code adopted by the board related to gas fitting not otherwise preempted by this Chapter, or any other related regulation as evidenced by an adjudication from a local governing authority.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Refusal of a master gas fitter to accurately designate an employing entity or provide notice of any change in employment
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The refusal of a master gas fitter to accurately designate an employing entity or provide notice of any change in employment with an employing entity.

insurance_required.quote: No master plumber license or master natural gas fitter license shall be issued, renewed, or revived until the applicant has provided proof acceptable to the board that insurance has been issued to the employing entity

definition_quote.value: Plumbing is the work or business of installing in buildings and on premises the pipes, fixtures, and other apparatus for supplying water, or removing liquid waste and/or water-borne waste, and fixtures, vessels and process piping that is in direct contact with products for human consumption.
definition_quote.quote: "Plumbing" is the work or business of installing in buildings and on premises the pipes, fixtures, and other apparatus for supplying water, or removing liquid waste and/or water-borne waste, and fixtures, vessels and process piping that is in direct contact with products for human consumption.

methods_authorized.quote: A "journeyman plumber" is a natural person who possesses the necessary qualifications and knowledge to install, alter, repair, and maintain plumbing systems

value: medical gas and vacuum systems verifier
license_tiers.quote: The board shall adopt tests of qualification to be possessed by any persons actually engaged in the alteration, installation, maintenance, or repair of plumbing in one- and two-family dwellings ... journeyman plumber ... master plumber

residential_scope_limited.quote: A "residential plumber limited" is a natural person who possesses the necessary qualifications and knowledge to install, alter, repair, and maintain plumbing systems and is licensed by the board to install, alter, repair, and maintain plumbing systems in one- and two-family dwellings at the direction of a master plumber without the supervision of a journeyman plumber.

residential_building_unit_cap.quote: licensed by the board to install, alter, repair, and maintain plumbing systems in one- and two-family dwellings

apprentice_supervision_requirement.value: Apprentices may engage in the art of plumbing only when they are under the direct, constant, on-the-job supervision of a licensed journeyman plumber.
apprentice_supervision_requirement.quote: Apprentices may engage in the art of plumbing only when they are under the direct, constant, on-the-job supervision of a licensed journeyman plumber.

value: pass a written and manual journeyman plumber's examination given by the board
qualify under the state board's regulations
journeyman_experience_pathways.quote: The board shall issue a license to any person who qualifies under the state board's regulations and who desires to engage in doing the work of a journeyman plumber if he passes a written and manual journeyman plumber's examination given by the board and pays the fees established by the board.

master_plumber_supervisory_experience_re.quote: The board shall issue a license to any licensed journeyman plumber or other person who qualifies under the board's regulations and who desires to engage in the work of a master plumber, provided he passes a written master plumber's examination

gas_supply_work_included_in_scope.quote: the board shall be the sole and exclusive agency in this state empowered to license any natural person or regulated business entity who is engaged or who seeks to engage in the business of gas fitting work for the general public that includes installation, repair, improvement, alterations, or removal of natural gas piping, tanks, and appliances annexed to real property.

natural_gas_appliance_certification_requ.quote: No person shall engage in performing the work of a gas fitter or master gas fitter unless he possesses a license or renewal thereof issued by the board.

contractor_qualifier_license_requirement.value: master plumber required for general plumbing contractor
contractor_qualifier_license_requirement.quote: No employing entity shall hold itself out as engaging in the business or art of plumbing unless it employs a master plumber.

minor_plumbing_repair_exemption.quote: Work done by an owner, management company, its agents, employees, or assigns for maintenance work to be carried out upon the owner's property, as such maintenance work is defined by rules of the State Plumbing Board. Such maintenance work shall specifically not include construction or installation.
